legal.privacy:
Quantum Africa (“Quantum Africa”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information of everyone who interacts with our website, programmes, events and community.

This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and the choices available to you.

Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with Quantum Africa, we may collect:

Name and contact information, such as email address.
Country, institution, university or professional affiliation.
Information provided when registering for events, programmes, courses or opportunities.
Information submitted through application, membership or interest forms.
Professional information, such as research interests, skills or LinkedIn profile.
Communications you send to us.
Technical information relating to your use of our website, such as browser, device and basic usage information.
Photographs, videos or other media captured during Quantum Africa activities, where applicable and subject to appropriate notice or consent.

We aim to collect only information that is reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it is collected.

How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to:

Provide and administer Quantum Africa programmes and services.
Register participants for events, courses and workshops.
Communicate with members, participants, partners and applicants.
Send newsletters, announcements and information about relevant opportunities.
Manage chapters, communities and programmes.
Improve our educational resources and digital platforms.
Facilitate research, mentorship and professional opportunities.
Understand participation and measure the impact of our programmes.
Maintain the security and functionality of our website.
Meet legal, regulatory or administrative requirements.

We will not use personal information for purposes that are incompatible with the purpose for which it was collected without an appropriate legal basis or, where required, your consent.

Newsletters and Communications

If you subscribe to a Quantum Africa mailing list, we may use your email address to send newsletters, educational resources, event announcements and relevant opportunities.

You may unsubscribe from non-essential communications at any time using the unsubscribe mechanism included in our emails or by contacting us.

Sharing Information

Quantum Africa does not sell personal information.

We may share information with trusted service providers where necessary to operate our programmes, website, registration systems, communication platforms or other services.

We may also share information where:

You have given permission to do so.
It is necessary to provide a service or opportunity you requested.
It is required by law.
It is necessary to protect the rights, safety or security of Quantum Africa, our community or others.

Where appropriate, we seek to ensure that third parties handling information on our behalf provide reasonable privacy and security protections.

International Transfers

Quantum Africa works across Africa and with international universities, organizations and partners. As a result, information may sometimes be processed or stored in countries other than the country in which you are located.

Where required by applicable law, we will take appropriate measures to protect personal information transferred internationally.

Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure.

However, no online system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, unless a longer retention period is required by law or is necessary for legitimate organizational purposes.

Your Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights concerning your personal information, including the right to:

Request access to information we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate information.
Request deletion of your information.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
Object to certain forms of processing.
Request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.

To exercise a right or ask a privacy-related question, contact us at:

Email: [privacy@quantum-africa.org]

Third-Party Services

Our website and programmes may use third-party services for event registration, email communication, analytics, hosting, educational platforms or other functions. These services may process information according to their own privacy policies.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will be published on this page with its updated date.

legal.conduct:
Quantum Africa Community Code of Conduct

Quantum Africa is committed to creating an open, respectful, inclusive and scientifically rigorous community where people can learn, collaborate, conduct research and build meaningful relationships.

Our community includes students, researchers, educators, professionals, entrepreneurs, mentors, universities, organizations and partners from across Africa and around the world.

Everyone participating in Quantum Africa activities is expected to contribute to a positive environment.

Respect Everyone

Treat all community members with professionalism, dignity and respect.

We welcome people with different backgrounds, disciplines, levels of experience, perspectives and areas of expertise.

Disagreement is acceptable.

Disrespect is not.

Learn and Collaborate

Quantum Africa is built around collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Members are encouraged to:

Ask questions.
Share knowledge.
Help newcomers.
Give constructive feedback.
Credit the work of others.
Collaborate across disciplines and countries.

We encourage healthy scientific debate while maintaining respect for other participants.

No Harassment

Harassment, intimidation, threats, bullying or unwanted personal attention are not tolerated.

This includes inappropriate behavior during:

Online discussions.
Discord and other community platforms.
Webinars.
Workshops.
Conferences.
University activities.
Meetings.
In-person events.
Private communications connected to Quantum Africa activities.

Professional Communication

Members should communicate professionally when representing Quantum Africa.

Do not use Quantum Africa platforms to:

Promote hate or discrimination.
Threaten or target individuals.
Share sexually explicit or abusive material.
Engage in personal attacks.
Spread malicious or deliberately harmful content.
Impersonate Quantum Africa or another community member.

Scientific Integrity

Quantum Africa promotes responsible and collaborative science.

Members should:

Give appropriate credit to collaborators.
Avoid plagiarism.
Clearly distinguish established results from speculation.
Respect research confidentiality.
Respect intellectual-property rights.
Avoid fabricating or deliberately misrepresenting scientific results.

Confidentiality

Information shared privately within research projects, applications, partnerships or organizational activities should not be disclosed publicly without authorization.

Members participating in specific projects may be required to sign additional confidentiality or intellectual-property agreements.

Representation of Quantum Africa

Only authorized representatives may speak officially on behalf of Quantum Africa or make commitments on behalf of the organization.

Chapter leaders and representatives should follow Quantum Africa's organizational, branding and communication guidelines.

Reporting Concerns

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, you are encouraged to report it to Quantum Africa.

Reports should be sent to:

Email: contact@quantum-africa.org

Reports will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible.

Consequences

Depending on the circumstances, violations may result in:

A warning.
Removal of inappropriate content.
Temporary suspension from community activities.
Removal from an event or programme.
Removal from a chapter or leadership position.
Termination of membership or participation.
Referral to appropriate authorities where required.

Quantum Africa will consider the circumstances and seriousness of each case when determining an appropriate response.

Our Commitment

We want Quantum Africa to be a place where someone can join with curiosity, regardless of their current level of knowledge, and find a community where they can learn, contribute, collaborate and grow.

Respect the community. Share knowledge. Build together.

pages.about.heroLede: Quantum Africa is building the people, knowledge, research capacity, and institutional connections Africa needs to participate in, and help shape, the global quantum future.
pages.about.whoWeAreBody:
Quantum Africa is a pan-African organization advancing quantum science and technology through education, research, talent development, and collaboration. We connect students, researchers, educators, universities, professionals, and partners across Africa and beyond.
Our work is focused on building lasting capacity—not simply delivering individual programmes or events. We create pathways that enable people to learn, develop skills, conduct research, access opportunities, collaborate internationally, and grow into leaders in the quantum ecosystem.
pages.about.storyBody:
Quantum Africa was with a simple conviction: Africa should not be a passive observer of the quantum revolution. The continent has talented students, researchers, and institutions, but greater access to education, research opportunities, networks, and global collaboration is needed to unlock this potential.

The organization began by bringing together students, researchers, and quantum enthusiasts through educational activities, community engagement, and knowledge sharing. What started as an initiative to make quantum computing more accessible gradually grew into a broader pan-African effort focused on developing talent and strengthening the emerging quantum ecosystem.

As the community expanded, Quantum Africa developed national chapters, educational programmes, research initiatives, workshops, webinars, and international collaborations, creating new pathways for African talent to engage with quantum science and technology.

Today, Quantum Africa is building the foundations for a connected continental ecosystem, linking people, universities, research, opportunities, and global partners to help develop Africa’s quantum capacity for the long term.
pages.about.missionBody: To build Africa’s capacity in quantum science and technology by expanding access to quality education, strengthening research and innovation, developing the next generation of quantum leaders and workforce, and connecting African talent and institutions with the global quantum ecosystem.
pages.about.visionBody: An Africa with the knowledge, talent, institutions, and networks to actively shape the global quantum future.
objectivesList: Expand quantum education across African universities and learning communities
Connect African students and researchers with global opportunities
Strengthen MSc and PhD pathways in quantum science and technology
Support collaborative research and develop pan-African research networks
Build partnerships between African and international universities and research institutions
Develop and strengthen Quantum Africa chapters across the continent
Increase African participation and leadership in the global quantum ecosystem.
pages.about.philosophyBody: We believe that access is the first step, but capacity is the goal. Education creates knowledge. Research turns knowledge into expertise. Connection creates opportunities for collaboration and growth. Leadership enables people to shape the future of the field.
